items.title: Tom Albert and Milton "Mooney" Martin Interview, 1964-12-21
items.q: The interviewer mentions Peter Bokhauser playing and the interviewee mentioning hearing him, but the interviewee's response describes a past event from 1905 with Tom Albert, not a direct personal interaction or relationship with Bokhauser.

ctx.x: The other night, we were over at Preservation Hall and Peter Bokhauser's playing, and you mentioned about the first time you ever heard him.
Can you tell us? 1905. 1905. 1905. 1905 with Tom Albert at the Flying Mexican Hall.
